current_evidence: The council's Local List page (marked 'Reviewed: 28 Oct 2026') states 'The current Local List was adopted on 3 January 2024' and links the four v4.0 January 2024 parts (Introduction, Annex 1 Minerals, Annex 2 Waste, Annex 3 County Development Reg 3), including Grokbot's Annex 3 PDF.

issues.detail: Annex 3 is the local list for the county council's own development (Regulation 3), yet Grokbot put every Annex 3 requirement under 'Full planning', most marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Its 'County own devt (Reg 3)' row says '(none) - national requirements only'. Examples: Travel Plan (all school developments increasing pupil/staff numbers), Transport Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Heritage Statement, Lighting, Noise, Open Space and Structural Survey. All belong under Reg 3.
issues.evidence: Annex 3 title: 'Annex 3 - County Development (Regulation 3)', v4.0 January 2024; workbook row 'County own devt (Reg 3)': '(none)'

issues.detail: Minerals and waste requirements are mixed up with Reg 3 ones. Annex 1 (Minerals) items were placed under 'Full planning': Agricultural Land Classification 8.3, Construction Traffic Management Plan 7.1, Contaminated Land 8.1, Construction Dust 3.2 and Statement of Community Involvement 15.1. Meanwhile the Annex 3 Contaminated Land trigger (15.1) was placed under 'Minerals & waste (county)'. Most 'Minerals & waste (county)' rows (Block plan, Roof plan, Floor plans/Elevations, Sections, DAS, Structural survey) come from the Introduction's generic drawing checklist, not from the minerals/waste annexes.
issues.evidence: Annex 1 7.1 'Where it is proposed to bring large plant ... onto the site'; Annex 3 15.1 'Contaminated Land Assessment ... previous uses of the site ... mineral extraction, waste disposal'

issues.detail: Grokbot did not capture these Annex 3 (Reg 3) requirements: Green Belt Statement (2.1, site within the Green Belt); Ecological Impact Assessment (3.2, natural/semi-natural habitat, protected species, or bat roof works); Great Crested Newts (3.3, red/amber NatureSpace impact risk zone); AONB Exceptional Circumstances Test (4.1, major development in an AONB); Ancient Woodland (4.4, within 500m of ancient woodland or veteran trees within 100m); Tree Constraints Plan (4.6) and Tree Protection Plan (4.7); Drainage and Water Supply Report (6.3, net increase in water/wastewater demand), which appears only as 'Water efficiency'; High Pressure Pipeline Search (8.2, any excavation or below-ground works); Airport Safeguarding Statement (10.1, within an aerodrome consultation area); and Pitch Layout Plan (13.1, school development on part of a playing field).

Grokbot did not capture these minerals/waste-specific requirements: Restoration, Aftercare and Enhancement statements (Annex 1 6.1-6.3, all mineral proposals except condition variations that do not affect restoration); Operational Dust Assessment (3.3, any minerals or waste development likely to create dust); Stability Assessment (8.2, substantial engineering works or unstable ground); Hydrogeological/Hydrological Report (9.3, significant ground works, dewatering, abstraction or infilling); Phasing Programme (Annex 1 14.1); Landfill and Landraising Statement (Annex 1 14.2 / Annex 2 14.1, any landfilling); Bio-Aerosols (Annex 2 3.5, putrescible waste with receptors within 350m); Other Pollutants (Annex 2 3.6, energy from waste, combustion, biomass/CHP). Odour (Annex 2 3.4, putrescible waste or composting within 250m of receptors) appears only mislabelled as 'Ventilation / Extraction details'.

Several requirement names are paired with text from a different requirement. 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' carries the Agricultural Land Classification trigger; no workers' dwelling requirement exists. 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' carries the LVIA trigger (4.2.1-4.2.2). 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' carries the Sustainable Design and Construction Statement trigger (11.1). 'Cycle parking details' and 'Electric vehicle charging details' both carry Transport Assessment 5.4.2 text. 'Block plan / Site plan' carries BNG text. 'Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment' quotes site-description text; Surrey has no coal-mining requirement, and the real Stability Assessment (8.2) trigger is missing. 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' gives only 'A soil management strategy where significant earthworks are required', not the Grade 1/2/3a trigger.
issues.evidence: Annex 1 8.3.1 'Where proposal affects the best and versatile agricultural land classified as Grade 1, 2 or 3a'; Annex 3 11.1.1 'Sustainable Design and Construction Statement ... Large school expansions, major developments (over 1000sqm)'

issues.detail: Several triggers are cut off or end in stray paragraph numbers. Examples: 'Planning Statement Required for the following applications: 1.1.' (the source says it is mandatory for all applications); 'Design and Access Statement Required for the following applications: 45.'; 'Environmental Impact Assessment Required for the following applications: 49.'; 'Biodiversity Net Gain Planning Applications What you must provide: 57.'; 'Tree survey / arboricultural implications Non-Material Amendment (NMA) Applications 68.'; Water efficiency '...20 v4.0 - January 2024 7.'. The Air Quality trigger is shortened to 'Major Developments (over 1000sqm)'; the full trigger also covers significant pollution, sensitive development in or near an AQMA, odour and new chimney stacks.
issues.evidence: Annex 3 1.1 Planning Statement 'mandatory for all planning applications'; 9.1 Air Quality list of triggers

issues.detail: Some placements contradict the source. 'Change of use - prior approval' lists a Construction (Environmental) Management Plan, but the quoted trigger explicitly excludes change of use ('All developments except very minor proposals such as canopies, fences, change of use'). 'Works to trees' lists the Arboricultural Impact Assessment, but that requirement applies to development proposals with trees on or near the site, and the county does not determine works-to-trees applications. 'Listed building consent' lists 'Character / Conservation area appraisal reference', which is LVIA 4.2 guidance text, not an LBC requirement. The SPA/HRA item went only under 'Outline', though the trigger says 'full or outline'.
issues.evidence: Annex 3 5.2.1 'All developments except very minor proposals such as canopies, fences, change of use'

issues.detail: About 30 'Submission rules' tab items are not requirements. Most are titles of guidance documents from the annexes' 'Policy and Guidance' boxes, e.g. 'Natural England - SSSI Impact Risk Zones (PDF)', 'Mayor of London Toolkit of measures to improve air quality at schools (PDF)', 'Protecting Green Belt Land (PDF)', 'Odour Management Plans for Waste Handling Facilities'. The rest are the web page's download list ('Files available to download ...'), process text (email to mwcd@surreycc.gov.uk, keep files below 10Mb, unlocked PDFs) and fragments ('Application documents ... and cheques submitted by post should be sent to:'). 'Pre-application advice' is listed as a requirement under two app types, but the source only encourages it.
issues.evidence: Annex 3 'Policy and Guidance' link lists; Introduction paras 15-18

issues.detail: The 'Policy-driven requirements' tab items are SPA background text cut into fragments, not requirements: 'The Surrey boroughs falling within this SPA, or its ZOI, are:', 'Elmbridge, Guildford, Surrey Heath, Runnymede, Waverly and Woking...', 'Parts of Tandridge District fall within the ZOI of this SPA.' (one fragment repeats the source typo 'Ashford Forest' for Ashdown Forest). The 'Identification of ... designations' item is cut off at 'public footp'.

Drawing-standard items repeat in several grammatical variants: 'Provides a drawing reference number and date. 28.', 'Provide a drawing reference number and date.', 'Provides a drawing reference number and date.', plus three versions of the scale-bar rule. 'Identification of any international, national, and local environmental ... designations' appears twice (Annex 1 and Annex 2), and so does the Alternative Site Assessment advice note.

The workbook link points only to Annex 3 (county council's own Reg 3 development). The local list has four parts: Introduction, Annex 1 Minerals, Annex 2 Waste and Annex 3 Reg 3. For a county planning authority the minerals and waste annexes are at least as central. The Local List landing page or Introduction PDF would be a better reference link.
issues.evidence: Local List page download list: Introduction, Annex 1 - Minerals, Annex 2 - Waste, Annex 3 - County Development (Regulation 3)

issues.detail: The list date is recorded as 2024-01-01 from the footer 'v4.0 - January 2024'. The council page gives the exact adoption date as 3 January 2024. Separately, 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' is misleading: the council reviewed the page on 28 Oct 2026 and still describes the 2024 list as current.
issues.evidence: 'The current Local List was adopted on 3 January 2024.' / 'Reviewed: 28 Oct 2026'

issues.detail: Householder, Advertisement consent, LDC, Works to trees, Demolition in conservation area and Permission in principle are marked '(none) - national requirements only'. A county planning authority does not determine these application types, so they should be marked not applicable rather than implying there are no local requirements.
issues.evidence: Local List page: 'validation requirements of planning applications submitted to the County Planning Authority' (minerals, waste and Reg 3 only)

summary: Grokbot's Annex 3 link is part of the current list (adopted 3 January 2024, still current per a page reviewed Oct 2026), but the extraction is poor. Every Reg 3 requirement was filed under 'Full planning' while 'County own devt (Reg 3)' shows none. Minerals and waste items are mixed up, many requirement-to-trigger pairs are wrong, and many minerals/waste requirements (restoration, aftercare, stability, hydrogeology, odour, bio-aerosols, landfill) were missed. The tab is padded with guidance-document titles and process text.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
